scope: Read-only source provenance and integration boundaries; no source repository mutation or native verification.

license.status: No project-level license found in checked root; do not infer redistribution rights.

sources.adapter_boundary: Planning preview, versioned course/task snapshot, explicit confirmation and durable execution receipt. Keep account identity at the gateway.
preserve: Check current state and expiry when confirming.
Repeated confirmation returns the original receipt.
SQLite transaction commits real plan changes atomically.
Course-overlap permission requires explicit current acknowledgement; do not silently override.
sources.integration_status: Source capability audited; no new integrated adapter or cloud verification claimed.

license.status: Third-party notices are present; they do not grant a license to the project as a whole.

sources.adapter_boundary: Evidence analysis result with source revisions, claim and calculation links, source-location precision and current-scope validation.
preserve: Do not invent original-page positions or evidence links absent from saved results.
Retain read-only bounded queries/calculations and separate analysis from plan mutation.
Legacy projected records remain distinguishable from fully recorded current results.
sources.integration_status: Source capability audited; no integrated source-change propagation or shared identity claimed.

license.status: No project-level license found in root or cached tree; public visibility is not a license.

sources.adapter_boundary: User-confirmed progress events and resumable work points with opt-in contextual memory; do not copy anonymous browser identity into team authentication.
preserve: Time spent does not imply task completion.
Memory is scoped to a user and requires consent before content transmission.
Local work remains saved when model/background processing fails.
Existing browser tokens and private memory must not migrate into examples.
sources.integration_status: Source capability audited; shared project progress and team identity adapter not implemented.

license.status: Third-party/runtime notices exist; no project-level license found in checked root. Audit assets, fonts and schemas before reuse.

sources.adapter_boundary: New restricted ReportSpec-to-JATS adapter followed by isolated job-based XML-to-PDF worker; do not pass arbitrary report JSON directly into DocumentIR.
preserve: Carry source/evidence and report version metadata through export.
Constrain report template and supported JATS subset in first release.
Verify fonts, XeLaTeX environment and output files in a later explicit worker spike.
Keep compile status separate from content correctness and from publication readiness.
sources.integration_status: Source capability audited; new report adapter and cloud worker not implemented or tested.

do_not_copy: API keys, access tokens, local .env files, personal provider configuration or credential stores
SQLite databases, private uploads, conversation histories, browser tokens, focus logs, account details and school records
Local caches, vector/model stores, test execution artifacts, exported user reports and logs
Bundled macOS/Windows runtimes, virtual environments, node_modules, SDKs or large model binaries
Unreviewed sample documents, licensed fonts, journal mastheads, schemas or third-party assets
phase_one_boundaries: Create a separate private repository with independent history; do not modify original repositories or their main/dev branches.
Keep pinned source commits and per-module provenance; do not flatten the four repositories into a new blanket license.
Use synthetic clearly labeled fixtures for first local scenario and state all external adapters honestly as unconnected.
Prioritize one scenario: a source revision marks linked claims, tasks and report sections for review, without claiming semantic discovery of all impacts.
Persist concrete state changes only after user confirmation; stale snapshots and repeated submissions must be handled.
No native SDK installation, no device validation and no paid model or AgentArts invocation is part of this source-baseline audit.
Do not claim a functional integrated product, actual AgentArts execution, multi-user authorization or PDF compilation from source inspection or mock UI alone.
